title: 公主：东方与远征（Princess: The East and the Expedition）
description:
PS：为满足所有玩家获取需求，此次QQ群将不定期进行清理，如有需要可重复添加。 感谢理解~

 We have gained the love of the majority of players, but also received everyone's feedback, we actively solve the rectification team. On the basis of continuing the story of the ancient romance, the game sequel "Princess: East and Expedition" has been developed. The game uses the meat pigeon gameplay to operate the protagonist's expedition to the four corners, opening a wonderful journey with the beautiful girl in different countries.

In terms of game development and production, we set up a more professional game team, abandoned AI and used pure hand-drawn painting and a large number of story texts, so as to bring the majority of players the feeling of being in the scene.

Finally, thank you for your support in the production of Princess: The East and the Expedition.

Princess: The East and the Expedition is a "Pretty girl +Roguelike+ real-time strategy" game.

As an expedition general appointed by the emperor, you need to use your wisdom and courage to expand your territory in unknown countries and uncover the conspiracies hidden in the dark depths. During the period you will also meet a variety of different styles of beautiful girls, to help you on the road to battle
